modalities.evidence: Raw T1 MRI images in nifti format

output.population: Bangladeshi children growing up in extreme poverty, followed longitudinally
output.summary: Longitudinal study of brain morphometry and physical growth in Bangladeshi children growing up in extreme poverty. Includes raw T1 MRI, age, sex, C-reactive protein elevations, growth measures, maternal education, income-to-needs and full-scale IQ.
